concerts.name: KARL LUTCHMAYER IN RECITAL
concerts.description: The Chamber Music Society of Colombo (CMSC) is pleased to announce a distinguished piano recital by the internationally celebrated pianist and musicologist Dr. Karl Lutchmayer. The performance will be held on Sunday, 11th October 2026, at 7:00 PM at the Goethe-Institut Hall, Colombo.In addition to the recital, Dr. Lutchmayer will conduct a masterclass for advanced pianists on Saturday, 10th October 2026, offering a rare opportunity for serious students and emerging professionals to engage directly with an artist of global stature. This concert is made possible through the generous support of Baurs & Co., The Rukmini Tissanayagam Trust, the Tokyo Cement Group, and the Goethe-Institut.Equally renowned as a soloist, chamber musician, and academic, Karl Lutchmayer holds the distinction of being the first Steinway Artist of Indian origin. His international career spans performances across four continents, with collaborations alongside conductors such as Sir Andrew Davis, Lorin Maazel, Neil Thomson, and Peter Stark. He has appeared with major ensembles including the Philharmonia Orchestra and the National Youth Orchestra of Great Britain, and has been featured on BBC Television and Radio, Classic FM, and All India Radio.In the UK, Lutchmayer is widely celebrated for his Conversational Concerts series, through which he champions both rare and contemporary repertoire.He has given over 90 world premieres of works by composers including Henri Dutilleux, George Benjamin, and Thomas Adès. His 2025 Chandos recording of Busoni’s solo and duo piano music with Peter Donohoe received extensive critical acclaim, with International Piano describing their ensemble playing as “magnificent” and Gramophone praising his “artfully balanced” artistry.Lutchmayer trained at the Royal College of Music, where he was awarded the Hopkinson Medal by Queen Elizabeth, The Queen Mother, before pursuing advanced studies under Lev Naumov at the Moscow Conservatoire. He holds an MPhil in Musicology from the University of Oxford and a PhD from the University of Cambridge. In 2015, he was honored with the Bharat Gaurav (Pride of India) Lifetime Achievement Award in recognition of his enduring contribution to Western classical music in India.Commenting on the upcoming engagement, CMSC Artistic Director Lakshman Joseph-de Saram said:“We are honored to welcome Karl Lutchmayer to the Colombo stage. Karl is a fiery virtuoso and a master communicator who unites formidable technical command with intellectual insight. Presenting an artist of his international standing in Sri Lanka aligns directly with the CMSC’s core vision of bringing world-class musical experiences to our audience.”Recital ProgrammeBeethoven — Sonata in B-flat major, Op. 22Haydn — Sonata in C major, Hob. XVI:50Grieg — Notturno, Op. 54, No. 4Brahms — Drei Intermezzi, Op. 117Ravel — Ondine from Gaspard de la Nuit, M. 55Liszt — 3 Études from Grandes études de Paganini, S. 141

concerts.name: KELE HANDA RUKMANI SWARNA GEE
concerts.description:
A concert that was meant to be her next musical celebration — but became a tribute to a legend.

“Kele Handa Rukmani Swarna Gee” revives the music of Rukmani Devi, the legendary actress, singer and first female superstar of Sri Lankan cinema, whose extraordinary voice and timeless artistry left an everlasting mark on generations.

This concert carries a special place in Sri Lankan musical history. It was originally scheduled to be performed by Rukmani Devi herself, but sadly, she passed away before that long-awaited performance could take place.

Decades later, her unfinished musical journey is brought back to the stage as a heartfelt tribute to the woman who helped shape the golden era of Sri Lankan music and cinema.

﻿හෙළ සංගීත ක්ෂේත්‍රයේ සදා නොමැකෙන ගීත රාශියක් නිර්මාණය කළ ප්‍රවීණ සංගීතඥ මහින්ද බණ්ඩාර ගී නිර්මාණ, අඩසියවසකටත් වැඩි තම සංගීත දිවියේ ප්‍රථම ප්‍රසංගය “මා නොගැයූ මගේ ගී” 

ගායන ශිල්පීන් 20 දෙනෙකුගේ ගායනයෙන්, ප්‍රවීණතම වාද්‍ය ශිල්පීන් 30 දෙනෙකුගේ වාදනයෙන්, ඉන්ද්‍රජිත් මිරිහාන සංගීත අධ්‍යක්ෂණයෙන් හැඩගැන්වෙන ආදරණීය රාත්‍රිය “රන්ගිර මා”


දෙසැම්බර් 13 වනදා සවස 6.00 ට BMICH හිදී.


අමරසිරි පීරිස්

අතුල අධිකාරී

සමිතා මුදුන්කොටුව 

නිරෝෂා විරාජිනී

දීපිකා ප්‍රියදර්ශනී

කසුන් කල්හාර 

ඉඳ්‍රචාප ලියනගේ

චඳ්‍රලේඛා පෙරේරා

චන්දන ලියනආරච්චි 

අසංක ප්‍රියමන්ත පීරිස්

අමල් පෙරේරා

ධම්මිකා බණ්ඩාර

කීර්ති පැස්කුවෙල් 

රජිව් සෙබස්තියන් 

ඉමාන් පෙරේරා

නාමල් උඩුගම 

කරුණාරත්න දිවුල්ගනේ

නීල් වර්ණකුලසූරිය 

චරිතා ප්‍රියදර්ශනී

ප්‍රදීපා ධර්මදාස

ඉන්දික ලියනගේ

concerts.name: CHANDRAYAMAYA
concerts.description: Chandrayamaya is an enchanting evening of timeless Sinhala music, bringing together some of Sri Lanka’s most beloved voices on one prestigious stage. Featuring the legendary Sunil Edirisinghe, the charismatic Keerthi Pasquel, the soulful Athula Adhikari, and the ever-popular Athma Liyanage. The concert promises an unforgettable journey through generations of cherished melodies and memories. With musical direction by Manoj Peiris and music by Three-Thaal, hosted by the renowned Manuranga Wijesekera, Chandrayamaya will take place on December 19 at 7.00 PM at the Musaeus College Auditorium Colombo.
